environment.description: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API) with Cognito User Pool authorizer. No WAF attached. API Gateway routes: GET /orders/{order_id} -> lambda_handler, POST /orders/batch -> batch_handler. DynamoDB table 'orders' has partition key 'order_id' (string). Any authenticated Cognito user can call any endpoint. Order IDs are sequential UUIDs (v1, time-based) making enumeration trivial.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no WAF WebACL associated
config.authorizer: Cognito User Pool (authentication only, no custom scopes)
